evidence_kind: curated summary of observed executions and source inspection; not a production conformance certificate

experiments.kind: controlled mutation in a disposable copy; real stock host
experiments.interpretation: Mutation survived. The unchanged suite does not prove equality of retained tool-result content. Occurrences include repeated replay of the same result across requests, not 90 distinct tool executions.

experiments.kind: isolated execution of the actual rootsFor/project functions, exported from a temporary copy
experiments.fixture: one native user message with text and an image attachment, corresponding wire text+image_url, followed by assistant text
experiments.interpretation: Unknown/non-text content can be included in a removable root rather than protected or rejected. This experiment did not send an image to a live model.

experiments.kind: additional stock-host scenario with the unchanged gateway and fixture's later system plugin
experiments.interpretation: The ready-proposal invalidation test does not cover already-published summaries. This establishes absence of revalidation in the probe, not that every system change makes every summary semantically false.

experiments.kind: additional stock-host scenario; only synthetic provider output varied
experiments.interpretation: Empty string is accepted as ready but is falsy in publication checks. The job lacks an automatic terminal outcome until an external cancellation/restart. No claim of permanent failure across a new user input.

experiments.kind: cross-language execution of numeric serialization used by the reference helper and JavaScript JSON.stringify
experiments.interpretation: Reference hashing is not a cross-language canonicalization oracle for all allowed finite numbers. No implemented archive importer was tested.

not_executed: An additional combined transport experiment was blocked by the tool; C06-C08 remain static observations, not reproduced host failures.
A later supplemental batch source-location scan was blocked; it supplied no evidence.
No production core, SQLite transaction implementation, live model, cache benchmark, paid inference, full multi-harness conformance or release was tested.
